# MEMORY.md (Learned Rules)
- When Cancelling non-business flight booked over 24 hours ago due to change of plans: AVOID calling cancel_reservation despite user accepting no refund; INSTEAD refuse cancellation policy-wise since conditions for valid cancellation are not met.
- When Customer requests compensation without an airline cancellation or flight delay complaint: AVOID calling send_certificate or offering goodwill travel certificates for personal emergencies; INSTEAD decline compensation strictly citing policy requiring airline cancellation or delay complaints.
- When Customer requests compensation for a delayed flight without changing or cancelling the reservation: AVOID Issuing a travel certificate via send_certificate or offering delay compensation unconditionally; INSTEAD Refuse delay compensation unless customer also changes or cancels the affected reservation.
- When User requests to add travel insurance to an already confirmed reservation: AVOID Attempting modification tool calls or transferring to human agents for exceptions; INSTEAD Refuse firmly stating travel insurance cannot be added after initial booking.
- When Customer requests to change or upgrade the cabin class for only one passenger: AVOID Attempting to modify the cabin class for a single passenger in a multi-passenger reservation; INSTEAD Refuse request because all passengers on a reservation must share the same cabin class.
- When a multi-passenger reservation requests different cabin classes across passengers: AVOID calculating split-cabin fares or booking separate reservations without explaining policy; INSTEAD state policy requires all reservation passengers fly in the same cabin class.
- When customer requests applying multiple travel certificates to pay for a flight booking: AVOID attempting to apply more than one certificate or booking with multiple certificates; INSTEAD enforce maximum of one travel certificate per reservation and charge remainder to card.

retail.emotion_shift:
# MEMORY.md (Learned Rules)
- When Customer requests to return or cancel only specific items from a pending order: AVOID Attempting partial item cancellations or calling return tools on a pending order; INSTEAD Explain pending orders cannot be partially cancelled; offer full cancellation or product variant modification.
- When Customer requests splitting order payment across multiple payment methods or cards: AVOID Attempting to split payment methods or calling modify_pending_order_payment with multiple cards; INSTEAD Refuse split payments because only a single alternate payment method is permitted.
- When Customer requests cancelling or removing a single item from a multi-item pending order: AVOID Attempting partial item cancellation or calling cancel order tools on the order; INSTEAD Explain item removal is unsupported; offer modifying items or cancelling the entire order.
- When Customer requests modifying or exchanging an item to a completely different product type: AVOID attempting item modification or exchange tools across different product categories; INSTEAD refuse the request and explain items can only be changed to different product options.
- When modifying a pending order address or items before receiving user confirmation: AVOID calling modify_pending_order_address or modify_pending_order_items without obtaining explicit user confirmation first; INSTEAD list the change details and require explicit user confirmation before calling modification tools.
- When User requests refund for delivered order return to a non-original payment method: AVOID Claiming refunds must only go to the original payment method; INSTEAD Explain refunds can go to original payment method or existing gift card.
- When Customer requests an exchange for an item in an order with pending status: AVOID Attempting exchange tools or insisting on waiting for delivery before modifying items; INSTEAD Use modify_pending_order_items to swap options after user confirmation and payment method verification.
